scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.prod:update:
echo '
--------Updating--------
' && npm run prod:stop && echo '
--------Stopped Old Server--------
' && git pull && echo '
--------Pulled Update--------
' && npm run install:all && echo '
--------Installed Dependencies--------
' && npm run prod:start && echo '
--------Started Server Again--------
'
